page_title: Roar: the open-source browser your AI agent can drive

sources.entry: Roar - Open-source agentic browser that uses local or bring-your-own AI models to navigate, read and fill the web for you. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/roarbrowser/roar) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Roar
summary.one_liner: Roar is a free, open-source browser for Mac that lets your own AI agent (via MCP) drive, read and fill in web pages in tabs you can watch and take over.
use_cases: Let an AI agent open and summarize your email inbox in a logged-in browser
Watch and take over pages an AI agent opens
Connect Claude Code, Cursor or Codex to a real browser via MCP
Run an agent in a hidden browser with its own profile
Organize tabs in vertical sidebar spaces with separate logins
Migrate spaces and pinned tabs from Arc
summary.what_it_does: Roar is a macOS browser designed so an AI agent can drive it like a user, using the user's existing logins in tabs visible in a sidebar. Agents connect through a bundled stdio MCP server (roar-mcp) that ships inside the app and can be added to clients such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Codex and Gemini CLI. The agent asks for permission on sensitive actions via sidebar cards, and a single click blocks the current space. The browser also offers spaces with separate tabs and logins, a vertical sidebar, pinned tabs, groups, split view, auto-archiving of idle tabs, a command bar (⌘T), reader mode and built-in uBlock Origin Lite. It can import data from Arc, Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge and Dia.
notable: Open source under MIT license with no built-in AI assistant; uses user-supplied agent over MCP
Agents act in the user's real logged-in browser, with ask-first permission cards and a one-click kill switch per space
Bundled MCP server requires no Node.js; one-click connect or manual config for many AI clients
Homebrew install available: brew install --cask roarbrowser/tap/roar
caveats: Mac only; requires macOS 13 or later
Agent connection requires a separate AI agent app such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex
